assumptions: Only conservative visually observed contact intervals may receive conditional ground force. Unreviewed, occluded and candidate frames do not.
The source sole point is the lower visible heel/toe landmark in the native image; it is approximate, can roll or drift, and is not a measured pressure center.
The target sole is an assumed world-down offset of 2.5 percent of target height from the ankle. No foot angle, foot mass or sole mesh is estimated.
Wall registration only co-registers image evidence. It does not calibrate floor metric distances. All ground support stays geometry-uncertain.
Ground normal is assumed model image-up. The configurable foot friction coefficient applies equally to ground and hold feet.
Floor polygons are manually estimated native-image regions interpolated between keyframes, not automatic wall/floor segmentation.
Ground observations stop at frame 74. Later unreviewed free limbs never acquire ground support by default.
Walking, rolling and lift-off are dynamic. The current solver remains quasi-static and does not prove no-slip or dynamic feasibility.
Fit weight 0.8 is an objective weight, not a calibrated contact probability; original classifier confidences remain unchanged.

left_foot.note: Visible shoe-floor contact; frames 3-5 are a rolling/lift transition and remain unknown.

right_foot.note: Visible floor contact during approach. Frames 21-32 include turning, rolling and lift-off; exact boundary left uncertain.
Foot above floor / moving onto wall hold; this does not itself confirm a particular hold.

visual_review_method: Assistant inspection of source-frame contact sheets and dense transition frames; not a user review or automatic segmentation.
